title: AI chat: two messages sent while a new conversation is being created, then a failed create, give back only the second message (the first is dropped)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named producer, measured by the developer of PR #33561 (#33420) with a rendered probe (report 6886717406, Acceptance notes "Two sends, then a failed create"). Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` + `ui/packages/app-shell`). Grade p3, self-graded by the lane seat under the maintainer's 「定级你可以自己决定」: a narrow path (two sends inside one held create, then the create fails) that drops typed text.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open ChatbotEnhanced restore` and `is:issue is:open first message create failed` find nothing open.

## What the user sees

On a new AI chat conversation, the user sends a message, then a second one while `POST /conversations` is still running. The create then fails. The "Couldn't send your message" notice shows and the message box gets back only the second message. The first one is gone: it is neither in the box nor sent on the retry.

## Where (after PR #33561)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` `useDeferredFirstSend` joins the two sends into one held message and, on the host's `createError`, drops it from the stash (so a retry does not send it twice).
- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` `ChatbotEnhanced`'s not-sent rollback restores its OWN last-submitted text, so only the second part comes back.

## Acceptance

- `ChatbotEnhanced` can take the text to restore from the host (an optional prop; Clause-② yes (widening) on `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, record owed), and `ChatPane` hands it the joined held text on a failed create.
- Pin through the rendered `AiChatPage` (the #33420 harness `AiChatPage.firstMessageDrawnAtOnce-33420.test.tsx`): two sends during a held create, 503 → the box holds both parts, first part first; retry sends the joined text once. CONTROL: one send restores as today.

Blocked-by: #33561
